S.FORM: lalu qalang mu ga Tgleq (Teliq, 鐵立庫部落), imi nya ga htagan na qsya aring gwagiq muci ke niya. cyux maki te Toyen keng pyasan na gogan (cobeh qalang Tayax na sincik), kinwagyq nya ga 1000-1500 meta. kayal nya krryax ga 21-23 kinhyaq nya. Aring cyama ru pwah sanmin mlu basu lga thoyay tehok qalang myan la. qalang Tgleq ru qalang Barung ga tmuhi qbirux kwara myan, pinmuhi myan qbirux ga hupa ru sbing balay, szyon balay muwah mkan okyak kahun hogan, bagan ga yasa qu pyang balay lmwan bway na qbirux. pyang blaq balay ga mwah simu qalang Tgriq ga maras simu nanak torak ga blaq, gi yaqih ngon basu nya kya. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 93% kyan ku 92 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 7% kyan ku 7 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 90%, Amis 1%, Truku 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 1%. maki qu ngasal bziran, ru kyokay. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Tgleq hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay 'zil na Tgleq hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Tgleq hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Tgleq hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Tgleq hya' ga Saruc. tay 'llaw na Tgleq hya' ga Tqwiy. rekisi kayal kyokay maki 1 kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: lalu qalaŋ mu ɣa tɣleq teliq ***** imi nja ɣa ħtaɣan na q[s|ɕ]ja ariŋ ɣwaɣiq mu[ʦ|ʨ]i ke nija [ʦ|ʨ]jux maki te tojen keŋ pja[s|ɕ]an na ɣoɣan [ʦ|ʨ]oβeħ qalaŋ tajax na [s|ɕ]in[ʦ|ʨ]ik kinwaɣjq nja ɣa ******** meta kajal nja krrjax ɣa **** kinħjaq nja ariŋ [ʦ|ʨ]jama ru pwaħ [s|ɕ]anmin mlu βa[s|ɕ]u lɣa tħojaj teħok qalaŋ mjan la qalaŋ tɣleq ru qalaŋ βaruŋ ɣa tmuħi qβirux kwara mjan pinmuħi mjan qβirux ɣa ħupa ru [s|ɕ]βiŋ βalaj [s|ɕ]zjon βalaj muwaħ mkan okjak kaħun ħoɣan βaɣan ɣa ja[s|ɕ]a qu pjaŋ βalaj lmwan βwaj na qβirux pjaŋ βlaq βalaj ɣa mwaħ [s|ɕ]imu qalaŋ tɣriq ɣa mara[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]imu nanak torak ɣa βlaq ɣi jaqiħ ŋon βa[s|ɕ]u nja kja [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku * ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** ami[s|ɕ] * truku * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran ru kjokaj rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na tɣleq ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na tɣleq ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na tɣleq ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na tɣleq ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na tɣleq ħjaʔ ɣa [s|ɕ]aru[ʦ|ʨ] taj ʔllaw na tɣleq ħjaʔ ɣa tqwij reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj maki * kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
